notes: Trimming now survives Speed and Reverse everywhere — the Tools panel, the prompt bar, and multi-step requests. Trim a clip down, ask Crisp to reverse or speed it up, and you get the piece you trimmed at the new speed; it used to come back as the whole original file with your trim gone. A caption with a start and end time also lands where you asked on a trimmed clip, instead of being burned in outside the part you export.
